Derivation_Source: Reynolds Transport Theorem; standard Courant condition applied to domain boundary migration
Justification: Prevents grounding line from migrating more than one full grid cell per timestep. Ensures pointer increment |g(n+1)-g(n)| <= 1. Required for the retreat and advance bookkeeping algorithms to function without ambiguity.

Justification: Well within CFL margin for slow sectors. Delta_t = 0.05 yr recommended timestep is safe.

Justification: Delta_t = 0.05 yr safe. Margin of 20x gives operational buffer.

Derivation_Source: Hypothetical extreme scenario beyond observed Antarctic Peninsula retreat rates
Justification: Delta_t must be < 0.05 yr. Flag RSK_NUM_08. Recommend Delta_t = 0.01 yr for extreme scenarios.

Expression: At each timestep n: compute v_GL^n_est = |x_GL^(n,est) - x_GL^(n-1)| / Delta_t  If v_GL^n_est > Delta_x / Delta_t: halve Delta_t; recompute
Units: Computed from two consecutive grounding-line positions
Derivation_Source: Prevents post-hoc discovery of CFL violation
Justification: v_GL^n_est can be estimated from the previous step or from the Schoof flux divided by H_GL * W_GL. This check runs BEFORE Step 2 (SSA solve) of the master algorithm.

Expression: Delta_t <= Delta_x / |v_GL|_max is a PROVISIONAL ENGINEERING LIMIT — not a mathematically derived stability criterion for the full 1D SSA system
Derivation_Source: Analogous to Picard convergence criterion: provisional, empirically motivated, subject to revision after Stage 1 calibration
Justification: The 1D SSA is a nonlocal elliptic operator; its true stability properties under moving-boundary remapping are more complex than a simple Courant condition. The CFL restriction is a conservative engineering safeguard, not a proven stability theorem.

Expression: RSK_NUM_08: Multi-cell GL crossing per timestep
Justification: If |g(n+1) - g(n)| > 1 is detected despite the CFL check: halt; halve Delta_t; redo the timestep. This is a hard enforcement condition.

Derivation_Source: Safe for |v_GL|_max up to 10,000 m yr^-1 (at the absolute limit); safe for |v_GL|_max up to 5,000 m yr^-1 with margin 2x
